subject: Social Media
title: Prebunking
description: A micro-lesson that makes Prebunking usable.

hook.text: A vaccine is coming. Before the anti-vax campaign starts, researchers inoculate the public—with information.

buildup.text: Prebunking teaches manipulation techniques before people encounter them. It's a vaccine for the mind.

discovery.text: Cambridge researchers created the game Bad News. Players learn disinfo tactics by using them. Resistance builds.

twist.text: Prebunking outperforms debunking. Preventing false beliefs is easier than correcting them once formed.

climax.text: Google ran prebunking ads on YouTube in Europe. Users became 20-30% better at spotting manipulation techniques.

punchline.text: The best defense against lies is knowing how they work.

quiz.question: How does prebunking differ from debunking?
options: It teaches manipulation tactics before exposure
It corrects false claims after they spread
